hypotheses.statement: Approvers will clear pending expenses from a mobile push notification instead of waiting for the weekly desktop session
hypotheses.success_metric: Approvers who opt in to the mobile pilot waitlist after the concept test

hypotheses.statement: Approvers can review a receipt, spot a policy violation and approve or reject in under 60 seconds on a phone
hypotheses.success_metric: Unassisted task success on the 'reject an out-of-policy receipt' task
hypotheses.threshold: at least 5 of 6 participants, median under 60 seconds

hypotheses.statement: Receipt OCR plus policy rules can flag out-of-policy lines with acceptable accuracy
hypotheses.success_metric: Precision of out-of-policy flags on a 200-receipt synthetic set

hypotheses.statement: Customers will pay for mobile approvals as part of the Business tier upgrade
hypotheses.target_segment: Economic buyers on the Standard tier
hypotheses.threshold: at least 3 of 8 buyers ask for a quote
